scope: Lei source-art facial paint callback, blink, restrained gaze, small mouth opening; no geometry/hair/live files modified

integration.recipe: config.paint = complete parsed lei-portrait-paint.json; parent wrapper must refresh embedded JSON
integration.immutability: Treat config.paint as immutable per head. Replacing it creates a new cached recipe; mutating it in place is unsupported.

state.blink: 0..1, eyelids occlude original iris; iris is not vertically scaled
state.gaze: [-1..1,-1..1], maximum source warp 6px horizontal / 3.5px vertical, 28px pinned boundary; subtle gaze only
state.jaw: 0..0.8, small source-lip opening, maximum depth recipe 25px * jaw

integration.face_domain: Source-coordinate polygon excludes source ears, jaw outline, neck and clothes. Final mask also covers every animated patch. faceFeatherPixels=18 is inward-only; no source pixels spread outside the polygon.
integration.caching: Source RGBA, mask distance transform, clean patches and extracted ink cached. Separate normal/under reusable full-size canvases keyed by normalized expression; repeated state does not rebuild composite. Changed gaze allocates only eye-sized warp canvases.

validation.canvas_preview: preview_portrait.mjs completed 11 states with no page errors; canvas_states.jpg uses uniform aspect ratio
validation.neutral_pixels: Both brow rectangles, nose and mouth equal the source exactly. Both eye rectangles retain every dark ink/iris pixel (source luma <175) exactly. Rectangle corner skin pixels near the face-domain edge differ by at most 6/255 left, 3/255 right; full metrics in neutral_feature_preservation.json.

warm_canvas_only.limitation: Not end-to-end renderer timing or a frame-rate claim.

validation.latest_candidate_3d: Not yet rendered by this agent. Parent is refreshing integration; r1 used older embedded recipe and must not count as final candidate approval.
validation.video: Not reviewed or approved by this agent.

r1_3d_observations: Viewed front, turn_45, turn_minus45, turn_60, turn_minus90, no_hair_45, no_hair_90, half_blink and talk. Neutral eyes/brows/nose/mouth track production source more closely than the old procedural paint.
Neutral +/-45 showed no static hard-cropped iris. Source facial identity is retained; apparent youthful round iris originates in production art rather than a replacement painted iris.

No-hair 45/90 revealed an abrupt orange source-shading band at the temple/forehead face-domain edge. Final frozen candidate adds inward feathering; 3D impact still requires refreshed views. Some source directional shading remains intentionally preserved.

R1 half-blink upper line appeared comparatively straight/heavy. Current recipe uses shallow closed curves and progressive ink thinning; full closure and live transition still need integrated inspection.
R1 talk at deep angle is a restrained small slit; no unsupported teeth or wide phoneme behavior is implied. Nose/lip/chin geometry is owned by deep_profile.
R1 rear side showed hair/floating-line issues outside this paint scope; hair agent/parent own these.
rejected_or_revised: 9px/5px gaze with 10px pin margin created a visible notch near the iris bottom. Reduced to 6px/3.5px and widened pin margin to 28px.
Deep closed-eye control points made a U-shaped lid and too much ink. Replaced by shallow closed curves and 0.48 final ink scale.
Narrow cleanup rectangle retained original outer eyelash points during closure. Expanded the cleanup ROI while keeping the source face-domain mask active.
Cleanup sampleTop across the inner brow shadow produced an orange vertical strip. Restricted clean sample X ranges to skin columns away from that shadow.

Initial 18px feather on the narrower mask attenuated outer eye ink. Expanded only the source-domain eye-height contour, then verified zero dark eye-pixel differences. World mapping and facial geometry were unchanged.
remaining_limits: Blinking uses extracted source ink and occlusion; mid-blink lid corners can look more squared and the lid flatter than the original open-eye drawing. Evaluate animation timing at actual output resolution before final acceptance.
Small gaze is a pinned local image warp, not an independently rendered eyeball. Larger gaze angles require separate iris/white artwork or a stronger deformation model.
Brows and nose are preserved source art; emotion-specific eyebrow expression and wide phoneme atlas are not implemented.
Final validation must rerun semantic decomposition then full face across both signs of yaw, inspect continuous turn and expression video, and verify wrapper/source hashes match the frozen candidate.
